Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

How much is it? · How many?
FormUseExample
How much?price / uncountableHow much is it?
How many?countable (plural)How many apples?
some / any+ / – / ?I have some euros.
I don't have any euros.
pricesay the priceIt's five dollars.
  • How much? = price OR uncountable: How much is it? How much money? How much water?
  • How many? = countable things (plural): How many apples? How many shoes?
  • some in +, any in – / ?: I have some money. I don't have any euros. Do you have any bananas?
  • Prices: It's five dollars. It costs ten euros. That's £5.75 (five pounds seventy-five).

→ Weather (It's raining) comes next.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: money, water (can't count) → How MUCH? apples, pens (can count) → How MANY?
  • ⚠ Сколько? / Қанша? = how much OR how many — first ask: can I count it one-two-three?

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write a short shopping dialogue: How much is it? / How many … ? .

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

How much is this T-shirt? It's cheap — only ten dollars. How many do you want? I'd like two, please.

Check yourself:

  • Did you ask How much / How many?
  • Is it How much for price and How many for things?
  • Did you use a price (dollars, euros, pounds)?
Talk to Sam. Answer with the words from this lesson.

Read each message. Tap 🔊 to hear Sam.

Sam

Hi! Welcome to my shop. 🛍️

Sam

Can I help you? 😊

Sam

It's twenty dollars. 🏷️

Sam

How many do you want? 🔢

Sam

Sure! 🛍️

Sam

Listen: “How much apples?” 🤔

Why

How MANY for countable things (apples). How MUCH for price / uncountable (money, water).

Sam

Yes! “How many apples?” Great catch. 🌟

Feedback

Well done: you used How much / How many and prices. Next time, say it out loud too.
